selection_basis: The supplied validation ledger only; no filtering by earlier speedups
runtime: same linked driver, timer and utility for all variants in a kernel/size; dynamic libraries fingerprinted
recheck_scope: same official input and the two already-frozen full-array inputs; check exact fresh native objects before measuring
batch_driver_check: same timed executable at K=1 and at reference-calibrated K; compare final official output outside timer
timer: CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW; accumulated per-kernel-call nanoseconds; initialization outside timer
state_reset: archived official init_array before each call, one untimed warmup; no whole-machine cache flush
address_randomization: host setting unchanged, no-PIE executable; stack/library/layout effects are not claimed eliminated
deduplication: exact linked executable SHA-256 within one instance, same runtime dependencies; independent identity-control execution retained
round_semantics: two traversals within one confirmation run, not independent machines, not independent LLM draws
within_instance_schedule: seeded permutation, every cyclic rotation and its reversal; repeat full cycle to have at least 8 complete blocks per round
estimator: geometric mean of per-round median paired timing ratios
time_or_quality_failure: record missing/invalid, no retry based on observed performance; do not claim failure equals numerical incorrectness
limitations: finite validation is not semantic proof
generation mode P0 versus P1/P2 confound remains
quality thresholds are not significance tests
two rounds do not remove all performance bias
